I want to talk about a program called E-Rate, which a lot of people aren't familiar with. So since the E-Rate program started, we've gone from about 12% of the nation's schools having internet to 95, 96% of the nation's schools having access to the internet. And, so it's a really important program. For LCPS, it's a sliding scale reimbursement program. For LCPS, about 50% of our technology costs that we invest in access, are reimbursed on an annual basis. For us, that's about a million and a half to $2 million a year.

For a lot of school divisions, it's 100% reimbursement. It is the way that they pay for access to the internet. It's hardware, it's the broadband services.
